create_jit_kernel: create a JIT-compiled kernel module from C++ or CUDA source files with header-only mode
build_cpp_args: build C++ template argument strings from Python types like torch dtypes, ints, floats, and booleans
test_cuda_arch: test the current CUDA architecture capability and retrieve major, minor, suffix info for JIT compilation flags
register_dependency: register a custom dependency with its include paths for JIT compilation, e.g. flashinfer or cutlass
override_cuda_arch: override the detected CUDA architecture temporarily within a context manager for JIT compilation
